NHLSettlementRules.section: General Hockey Settlement Rules, printed page115
NHLSettlementRules.summary: Standard full-game hockey markets include overtime; a shootout adds one goal to the winning team and game total. Regulation/ExclOT/60minute and period exceptions remain excluded. Individual player statistics exclude the shootout.

notes: Real production data and APIs were not mocked. Source goal prices and exact total line were matched against visible UI, and a different manual line did not borrow that price.

Player goal-shot counts and latest5 were recomputed from atomic rendered observations for the exact line. Historical minutes are included only for the same complete set of games; future role/time is not inferred.

NHL team markets use official full overtime/shootout results, with one extra official shootout-winning goal, not all shootout attempts. Player S markets include overtime but exclude shootout attempts; shot attempts are not relabelled shots on goal.

Historical form, scored/conceded goals, actual venue samples, medians, variability and counterevidence remain visible even at a minOdds100 filter or without a price. Confirmed starting goalies, xG, special-teams strength and save rates were not invented.
Descriptive directions have unverified predictive accuracy; no win probabilities or EV were introduced. No paid services were added.
NBA player-first layout, exact Cade AST6.5 fixture, explanations, strict pricing and expansion were separately checked with controlled fixtures. Frozen data/models/history workflow were unchanged.
